aboutIntro: Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, izifundo, umphakathi nokunye okuningi ukukusiza ufunde futhi ukhulise i-HAX.
haxDescription: I-HAX iyisistimu yokubhala yomdabu wewebhu eyakhelwe ukushicilela okuqukethwe okufinyelelekayo nokunezingxenye ezindaweni eziningi zokuletha.
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Kubhaliswe maphakathi ku-HAXcms futhi kuboniswa ngokomongo osebenzayo. Ukubopha kusebenzisa i-Ctrl+Shift+[Ukhiye]; kusihleli, ukuthayipha isiqalisi se-markdown bese kulandela isikhala kuguqula ibhulokhi. Thayipha u-{slash} ebhulokhini lombhalo elingenalutho ukuze uvule Usesho lomugqa.
tutorialsDescription: Qala ngemisebenzi eqondisiwe, bese udlulela ezifundweni zesinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
apiLinksDescription: I-HAXcms ingashicilela amakhasi ngamafomethi alungele imishini ukuze amathuluzi e-LLM akwazi ukufunda nokucubungula okuqukethwe kwakho ngokuhlanza okuncane.
apiLinksFormats: Engeza u-{formats} kuma-URL wamakhasi ukuze ucele okukhishwayo kwamanye amakhasi.
apiLinksLlms: Sebenzisa u-{llms} njengenkomba ebhekiswe kumamodeli yale sayithi, enezixhumanisi zezinsiza ezibalulekile ezifundeka ngemishini.
apiLinksPair: Hlanganisa u-{siteJson} (isakhiwo) no-{searchIndex} (ukubuyisa) ukuze uthole izinqubo zokusebenza eziqinile ezisebenzisa i-AI.
